stem: Meera heats a vessel of water on a stove in her kitchen. The water at the bottom of the vessel gets heated first. What happens to this heated water, and why?

options.text: It stays at the bottom because warm water is heavier.
It rises because it expands and becomes lighter, and cooler water moves down to take its place.
It sinks because cooler water from the top pushes it down.
It rises only after the water starts boiling and bubbles appear.

teacher.key_rationale: Heated water expands, becomes less dense (lighter), and rises; cooler, denser water moves down to replace it, setting up a convection current. Only option B states both the rise and the reason correctly.
